source_matrix.additional_roles_condition: ACTION_RESULT requires independently authenticated execution/result source joined by exact producer/record identity. ACCEPTED_KNOWLEDGE additionally requires typed acceptance and current support. No chronology-based promotion.
source_matrix.decision_rule: For an actual source: required operational clause -> MIGRATED_OPERATIONAL; otherwise historical-role -> HISTORICAL_ONLY; otherwise referenced authentication dependency -> MIGRATED_PROVENANCE_ONLY; otherwise audited irrelevant -> NOT_REQUIRED. Unknown role blocks. Virtual expected-source record -> REPRESENTED_AS_EXPECTED_ABSENCE only with exact governing gate. Mutually exclusive by precedence; all fields retain role tags.
source_matrix.invalidation: Historical record remains; any current interpretation dependent on invalidated source becomes stale; never erase required edge to increase readiness.
source_matrix.selection_execution_rule: Selection is planning observation only, never result/knowledge production
